name: jsettlers-va-dev-t8
purpose: value-arms DEV JSettlers table (experiments/value-arms-dev.json): planner_pv2_tiles_va_t8 alone vs three all-SMART JSettlers 2.6.10 robots, base seed 20261119, 1024 games; the planner_pv2_tiles run is the shared control, paired by game name with each candidate's run.
analysis: scripts/jsettlers_paired.py --alpha 0.05 --expect-games 1024 --point-bar 0.02 (candidate vs the tiles control); the DEV verdict is 'dev_pass'.
limitations: The patch file is GPLv3-derived and lives only in runs/external (never in this repo); its sha256 is pinned here. all_smart makes every locally started robot use JSettlers' SMART strategy params, including our extrabot's inherited fallback brain.
note: Predeclared 2026-11-10 before any game; fresh base seed 20261119; launch with `uv run --with numpy`.
